steps.content: Risk of a Black Ring outbreak confirmed; risk level upgraded to S+; Ground zero presumed to be Sinner Zoya; troops for deployment in the risk area are Team FAC-BR-N7 and MBCC's Sinner squad.
Go to the conference hall now. Kill Sinner Zoya before the concentration of contamination reaches the threshold level.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Yes, Chief!

options: Hold on. I can't accept this decision!

steps.content: The negotiation's apparently a plot. The Public Security Bureau and the force behind the inheritance are involved. We haven't found out about the truth yet; we can't just declare Zoya the culprit.
...Chief, a disaster is imminent. This is the only possible course of action.

options: The inheritance, not Sinners, is the source of Mania.

steps.content: I saw it happen with my own eyes in the cave. The inheritance, which is used to produce Mania weapons, turned humans into Maniacs and then swallowed them to boost its own power.

I agree with you in that regard. This crisis is far more serious than the FAC expected. 80% of the anti-Black Ring system has been damaged, which is proof enough that the inheritance is much more powerful than we thought.
But when you come down to it, the inheritance is just a catalyst; all this can be traced back to Zoya's mental contamination. We have to eliminate the source to dissolve this crisis.
I understand how you feel, and I'm really sorry, but this is the only way out.
As he says these words, his face is a study in composure. His composure was what earned your trust, but now it chills you.

options: Is this a fact, or some resentful prejudice of yours?

steps.content: Sinners are the source of contamination and disasters... This isn't the first time I've heard this. Ignore a blatant plot, abandon all other solutions, pin everything on Sinners, and problem solved.
This way of thinking can only bring more tragedies. Syndicate can't take it anymore.
Before 036 can respond, another person has come forward.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Blah, Blah, Blah... so annoying. Captain, I'll carry this motormouth with me. Stop wasting our **** time!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What do you think you're doing?! Get your hands off the Chief!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Take your filthy paws off me!! The DisCity got to where it is today because of you, you thugs, monsters! Get lost!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Tragedies? If you had the slightest idea what real tragedies look like, what we are fighting, you wouldn't think to defend the Sinners!
Clang! The soldier's outcry has stopped; he lets go of you, kneeling on the ground in pain.
Standing behind him is 036, who has just dealt a mighty blow to his subordinate and is withdrawing his hand, but his face is completely devoid of anger.
...Stop it, 702. The depletion of your Hypercubes is speeding up. Don't lose control of your emotions. You don't want to get infected with Mania here, right?
Start mind suppression immediately.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Cough, cough... Sorry, Captain. I'll keep my emotions under control, sorry.
036 says no more. He turns to you, and the two Sinners supporting you become alert.
We didn't mean to antagonize you; we don't hate Sinners. Our only enemy is the imminent catastrophe.

For the purposes of our upcoming task, I hereby, in accordance with Supplemental Clause 74 of the <color=#fb9259>Code of Confidentiality</color>, divulge to you part of the FAC's confidential information, and assume accountability thus incurred.

Everything you see now, from the corruption incidents caused by the contamination to this unsettling turn of events, is just a prelude. The <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>, keep the name in mind... it's the ultimate form of a Mania crisis.
It's an area that causes <color=#fb9259>widespread, severe mental contamination</color>. It appears when a Mania crisis goes beyond its limits; it's a no-go zone of Mania that can not be eliminated.
Information about what's going on inside the Black Ring is extremely rare, since few can get out alive. We've only recorded the damage caused by the Black Ring.

<color=#fb9259>BR-000</color> appeared in N.F. 84, in the wake of the <color=#fb9259>DisSea explosion</color>. The number of direct deaths was 87,231, and up until the appearance of BR-001, more than 200,000 Maniacs had come into being.

<color=#fb9259>BR-001</color> appeared in N.F. 89. More than 30,000 people went missing, with an annual addition of at least 200 people. 3 years later, the contamination spilling out of BR-001 formed the <color=#fb9259>Isolation Belt in the Rust</color>, which we still aren't able to clean up.
Access to data on BR-002 and BR-003 is blocked. <color=#fb9259>BR-004</color> is coming.

options: But no one in the city has ever talked about the existence of the Black Ring

steps.content: Because the FAC has to do its utmost to stop any Black Ring-related information from getting out, in order to prevent secondary disasters, that is, the unpredictable, far-reaching spread of Mania.
Every time a Black Ring appears, the number of mental cases in the city skyrockets.

You don't have to be in contact with contamination to get mentally ill. You might get mentally ill simply by observing a Black Ring, discussing it, or even imagining it. We can't manage the influence of a Black Ring when it's out in the open.

And we humans have no way of eliminating a Black Ring once it has appeared. All we can do is to contain its expansion and lessen its effect by blocking the contamination, Active Camouflage, and information control.

This is why information on the Black Ring is strictly confidential. <color=#fb9259>The Black Ring is the source of Mania</color>, and simply knowing this piece of information might be enough to bring destruction on ourselves.

options: How does that have anything to do with Sinners

steps.content: Misunderstanding caused by information blocking does contribute to Sinners being blamed for causing Mania. But there's a close link between the appearance of a Black Ring and the behavior of a Sinner.

With the exception of BR-000, whose point of origin hasn't yet been determined, we detected a powerful Sinner going manic at the same time when each of the other Black Rings appeared. Such a Sinner is called <color=#fb9259>Black Ring Ground Zero</color>.

The M value of Sinner Zoya is already out of range. Once she is corrupted, a Black Ring will descend on Keylan Square immediately. Then, no one inside the ring will survive, and those outside the ring are not going to emerge unscathed.

The <color=#fb9259>Framework Against Catastrophe</color> is not trying to sit in judgement on Sinners, or improve public morals. We have only one job, and that is to do everything we can to fight Mania, to prevent the ultimate catastrophe that we humans wouldn't be able to survive.
Killing Zoya is the only course of action that can stop this catastrophe. That's what we'll do. And without you, we don't stand a chance of defeating her.

options: This is why you're protecting me?

steps.content: That's right.
...I'm very sorry.
What if I don't agree? Would you force my hand?
His eyes widen, but it's not a reaction to what you've just said.
Enemies! Get down!!

Spikes of contamination are flying your way. A few forms in white are scrambling to stand in front of you. The first one to manage that is the soldier who a moment ago was yelling at you while clutching your collar—Soldier 702. His body has been pierced.
Cough... Captain, ten o'clock... Quick...
036 doesn't say a word. He picks up a gun and starts shooting at that direction. After suppressing the enemy, he picks up his ax.
